messages:
Maya: Heads up — we've got a visitor (client) coming Sat 11:30, bringing a corgi. Do we have a pet badge or a label for the corgi? Also a courier left a fragile crate of vintage sodas in the lobby, label says 'DO NOT STACK'. Anyone able to pick up before 5pm?
Tom: Aww corgi :heart_eyes: We don't have pet badges per se. Front desk can print a 'Visitor + Pet' sticky.
People Ops Bot: new visitor registered: Maya's guest (Sat 11:30). Badge printed? Reply `yes` to confirm.
Iris: I can swing by after standup at 4 to move the crate to the mailroom. Where is it exactly?
Maya: It's on the lower shelf near the east lobby bench, third from the door. There's a kid-proof tape around it.
Devon: Note: badge printer jammed yesterday. If front desk needs to print, try `printer reset 2 && printer feed 1` (frontdesk account). If that fails, the label maker in meeting-room B works as backup.
Tom: Also can we reserve the small meeting couch by reception for the client chat? It's comfy for corgi cuddles.
Maya: Yes plz. Also thinking of bringing extra dog treats — if anyone's allergic pls say now :grimacing: 
Leo: allergic to peanuts, but treats usually fine. I'll add a 'no peanut' note to the visitor form.
People Ops Bot: package scanned: vintage-sodas-CRATE (fragile) — courier says 'leave with front desk' — tracked by #PKG-7781
Iris: I'll take photos when I move it and will tape the 'fragile' sticker more visibly.
Maya: huge thanks! If anyone can help carry it's heavy.
Tom: I can help at 4:15.
Devon: If badge printer acts up, DM me and I'll remote in.
Maya: ok all set, corgi is named Nugget :dog: See you Saturday — and thanks for the rescue on the crate :bow:
People Ops Bot: Reminder: weekend office volunteers needed for Saturday 9am mail sweep. React with :raised_hands: if you can help.
Iris: +1 volunteer
Tom: +1
